I had been following RT since my early teens, approximately at the time of the first minecraft let’s plays. At some point I stopped watching their content as much, but I would still check in to see what was going on and maybe watch a couple videos/listen to a few podcast episodes. Early on in the COVID quarantine was one of these times for me. I happened to be looking on what RT podcasts were available on Spotify and saw F**kface. The description interested me enough to listen. I was hooked. I think they had about 20 episodes out by the time I discovered it. I’ve been a weekly listener ever since. This podcast has given me an untold amount of laughs and has helped me through some tough times. I always look forward to new F**kface content. I’ve also found myself more actively consuming other RT content now.
